headline: Physical climate risks are now hitting P&L and cash flows across all sectors today, not just in scenario analysis — no sector is unaffected as a super El Niño approaches
reasoning: Claudia Kwan argues that climate risk has shifted from a theoretical scenario-analysis exercise to a real-time earnings and cash-flow event. Severe weather events mean the statistical risk is now materialising on company P&Ls. She notes this is not confined to one sector but is pervasive across entire portfolios, and the approach of a super El Niño compounds the urgency.
quote: I think what what's happening more recently is with severe weather events is that that risk in terms of a statistical event, is now actually coming on the PNL and on the cash flow today. And it's not really pertained to one specific sector. It's actually across the whole portfolio.
